description: This PHP source file defines the 'Theme' controller class within the Opencart admin panel, handling CRUD operations, listing, enabling/disabling, and template management for themes.

classes.name: Theme
classes.description: Controller class for managing themes in the Opencart admin panel, including listing, editing, enabling, disabling, and deleting themes.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to display the theme list page with filters and navigation links.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Calls the getList method to display the list of themes.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and renders a paginated list of themes based on filters.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing a theme, including loading templates and stylesheets.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Loads and returns the content of a specified template file in JSON format.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving a new or existing theme, including permission checks and file validation.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables selected themes by updating their status.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables selected themes by updating their status.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected themes from the database.
